They do exactly the same thing

questions.q: In the format code "%Y-%m-%d", what does %m represent?
options: A 2-digit month
Milliseconds
A 4-digit year
Minutes
questions.explain: %m is the format code for a 2-digit month; %M (capital) is minutes.
